**Continuous 2.38.4**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.38.3, 2.38.2, 2.38.1, 2.38.0, 2.36.0, 2.34.0, 2.32.0, 2.30.0, 2.28.0, 2.26.0, 2.24.0, 2.22.0, 2.20.0, 2.18.0, 2.16.3, 2.16.2, 2.16.1, 2.16.0, 2.14.0, 2.12.x, 2.10.x or 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.38.4.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                       |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.38.4.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.38.4.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.38.4.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.38.4.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.38.4.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.38.4.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.38.4-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.38.4.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.38.4-vscode/continuous-cli-2.38.4.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). The short command `cn` also works; both run the same program. It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.38.3

The chat input has a Thinking menu for the current mode. A reply can be copied as Markdown. A Windows path inside the open workspace is no longer treated as outside it when only the spelling differs.

Model information updates stay automatic. About 15 to 60 seconds after start, and again while Continuous is open, a copy older than 24 hours is downloaded. That list supplies context sizes and prices. The selected provider's own facts, including a Bedrock price list, refresh on the same interval when that provider is in use. Settings > Models > Model information updates can be set to Only when I ask or Off. A test connection still lists that provider's models.

No new host is contacted by the extension or the terminal agent.

### New

- **Thinking.** The menu offers Default, Off, Low, Medium and High. It writes that mode's reasoning effort, the same field as Settings > Models > Which model does what. A model that cannot think hides the menu. The reasoning toggle, once clicked for that model, still overrides the level.
- **Copy as Markdown.** The reply menu copies Markdown, or plain text. Ctrl+Alt+C (Cmd+Alt+C on macOS) and Continuous: Copy Message as Markdown copy the focused reply. Reasoning is left out. The copy starts with the chat title and the date.
- **Permission confirmation.** Settings > Tools has Skip the confirmation when permissions change. It is off, so the save dialog still appears. On, that dialog is skipped. An ask before a command runs is unchanged.

### Fixes

- **Windows paths.** Creating or editing a file inside the open workspace no longer asks as if the file were outside it when the paths differ only by slash direction, drive-letter case, or a trailing separator. A file that is outside the workspace still asks.
